description: The two §5.6 embedding modes trade availability, never integrity.

sources.toml:

schema_version = 1
name = "oil"
version = "1.4"
[unit.bbl]
dimension = "length"
factor = [9938205933, 62500000000]
display = { long = "oil barrel" }

cases.rationale: In full mode the provenance block carries registry.source, so the table resolves with no network and survives the constituents disappearing.

cases.rationale: Pin mode omits registry.source but carries the same hash: integrity is identical, availability is not.

cases.rationale: A fetched registry that does not match the pin MUST be refused, not used. This is what the hash buys over a bare URL, and it holds in both embedding modes.
